unsupported_term_policy: The listed terms are established translator/ledger choices or the supplemental codomain clarification, not newly found canon quotations. Preserve their consistency and flag for native review; no unsupported claim of direct canon attestation.
material_decisions_for_root_log: Preserve all eleven definitions in EN source order, not Vietnamese alphabetical order; each definition and meaning has its exact source ID.
Function means exactly one output for every input in the domain, not merely at most one on an arbitrarily prescribed domain.
One-to-one refers to outputs actually attained, namely the range; no surjectivity onto a larger target set is introduced.
Horizontal-line test presupposes a function. Two labeled finite supplementary relations distinguish repeated outputs from repeated inputs.
English final definition says a vertical line; Indonesian says every vertical line. Translate the intended universal quantifier explicitly and explain allowed zero intersections outside the domain.
Keep general relation/input/output wording broad enough for objects or labels, consistent with U001's explicit OpenStax convention.
No source equations, exercises, solutions, tables, links or media exist in this glossary. Supplemental finite examples are not counted as source exercises.
